facts.claim: French firm Hynaero and Leonardo will explore how they can collaborate on the development and production of a next-generation amphibious firefighting aircraft.
On October 23, 2026, Hynaero said a Memorandum of Understanding had been signed with Leonardo to define collaboration over major aero structural components for the Fregate-F100 program.
The Fregate-F100 is designed to carry a 10-ton water payload and help secure European and French sovereignty over aerial forest firefighting capabilities.
The aircraft is intended to perform its first test flight in 2030 and launch the following year, according to Hynaero's website.

Under the MoU, potential collaboration areas include aircraft aerostructure design-build, testing-validation, engineering, certification, industrialization, maintainability, system design and build, promotion in Italy and export opportunities.
The Fregate-F100 concept validation was carried out in 2025, supported by institutional and industry partners in Europe.

Key features include a 250 knots cruising speed, more than four hours of firefighting autonomy at a distance of 250 km from its home base, a ferry range of up to 2,500 km, fly-by-wire controls, a head-up display and predictive maintenance.

zh.title: Hynaero與李奧納多擬合作開發新一代兩棲滅火機
zh.summary: 法國Hynaero與李奧納多簽署合作備忘錄，擬就Fregate-F100兩棲滅火機的主要航太結構件展開合作，該機設計載水量10公噸，目標2030年首飛、隔年投入使用。
body: 法國業者Hynaero與國防航太集團李奧納多將探討如何合作開發與生產新一代兩棲滅火機。Hynaero於2026年10月23日表示，雙方已簽署合作備忘錄，擬就Fregate-F100計畫的主要航太結構件界定合作範圍。Fregate-F100設計載水量為10公噸，目標是鞏固歐洲與法國在空中森林滅火能力方面的自主性。

合作可能涵蓋機身結構設計製造、測試驗證、工程、認證、工業化、維護性、系統設計製造，以及在義大利的推廣與出口機會。李奧納多在機身與機翼等主要結構件生產方面具領先地位，並在空中緊急應變與滅火領域擁有專業經驗。Fregate-F100概念驗證已於2025年完成，並獲得歐洲機構與產業夥伴支持；該機關鍵性能包括巡航速度250節、在距基地250公里處具備逾4小時滅火續航力、轉場航程可達2500公里，並配備線傳飛控、抬頭顯示器與預測性維護系統，目標2030年首飛、2031年投入使用。

en.title: Hynaero and Leonardo to explore collaboration on next-generation amphibious firefighting aircraft
en.summary: French firm Hynaero and Leonardo have signed a memorandum of understanding to define collaboration over major aero structural components for the Fregate-F100, a 10-ton water-payload amphibious firefighting aircraft targeted for a first test flight in 2030 and launch the following year.
body: French firm Hynaero and defense and aerospace group Leonardo will explore how they can collaborate on the development and production of a next-generation amphibious firefighting aircraft. On October 23, 2026, Hynaero said a Memorandum of Understanding had been signed with Leonardo to define collaboration over major aero structural components for the Fregate-F100 program. The Fregate-F100 is designed to carry a 10-ton water payload and help secure European and French sovereignty over aerial forest firefighting capabilities.

Potential collaboration areas include aircraft aerostructure design-build, testing-validation, engineering, certification, industrialization, maintainability, system design and build, promotion in Italy and export opportunities. Hynaero highlighted Leonardo's position as a leading supplier of main structures such as the fuselage and wings and its expertise in aerial emergency response and firefighting. Concept validation for the Fregate-F100 was carried out in 2025 with support from institutional and industry partners in Europe, and key features include a 250 knots cruising speed, more than four hours of firefighting autonomy at 250 km from its home base, a ferry range of up to 2,500 km, fly-by-wire controls, a head-up display and predictive maintenance. The aircraft is intended to perform its first test flight in 2030 and launch the following year.
